From the Experimental Section:

For Ge-poor ITH (Si/Ge = 13.3):
- GeO2 was dissolved in a 1M solution of HM (hexamethonium) dihydroxide
- TEOS was added
- Gel composition: 0.90SiO2:0.09GeO2:0.25HM:5H2O
- Temperature: 175°C
- Time: 14 days with slow stirring (60 rpm)

For Ge-rich ITH (Si/Ge = 2.3):
- TMHDA (NNN'N'-tetramethyl-1,6-hexanediamine) as SDA
- Fluorine anions present
- Gel composition: 0.5SiO2:0.5GeO2:7TMHDA:1.4HF:44H2O
- Temperature: 175°C
- Time: 6 days under static conditions

For IWW samples:
- MPP (1,5-bis(methylpyrrolidinium)pentane) dihydroxide as SDA
- Gel composition: (1-x)SiO2:xGeO2:0.25MPP:10H2O
  - For Ge-rich IWW (Si/Ge = 2.9): x = 0.33
  - For Ge-poor IWW (Si/Ge = 7.2): x = 0.2
- Temperature: 175°C
- Time: 7 days

For UTL samples:
- DMAD ((6R,10S)-6,10-dimethyl-5-azoniaspiro[4,5]decane) as SDA
- Gel composition: (1-x)SiO2:xGeO2:0.25DMAD:30H2O
  - For Ge-rich UTL (Si/Ge = 3.8): x = 0.33
  - For Ge-poor UTL (Si/Ge = 6.0): x = 0.17
- Temperature: 175°C
- Time: 6 days with agitation (60 rpm)
